class.name: IfcProjectLibrary
class.brief_description: IfcProjectLibrary collects all library elements that are included within a referenced project data set. Examples for project libraries include: type libraries (also called style or family libraries): a collection of subtypes of IfcTypeObject property definition libraries: a collections of IfcPropertySetTemplate or IfcPropertyTemplates HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4. Attribute use definition SELF\Ifc
